titleEn: Latest grain-handling equipment focuses on capacity and convenience
titleZh: 最新粮食处理设备聚焦产能与便捷性
summaryZh: 本文报道了在农场进步展上发布的最新粮食处理设备，重点介绍了Vari-Air、Walinga、AGI、Shivvers和KSI等公司推出的新产品。这些设备通过更大的气力系统、更快的输送机、集成自动化控制和改进的安全功能来提升粮食处理产能和便捷性，包括每小时处理数千蒲式耳的气力系统、行业首创的机械摆动式输送机、集烘干与仓储监控于一体的控制系统，以及专为粮食掩埋紧急情况设计的救援设备。
featuredReason: 虽然本文主要聚焦大田粮食处理设备，但其在气力输送系统、集成自动化控制和设备安全设计方面的创新思路，对智慧畜牧行业的饲料处理和物料输送环节具有跨领域借鉴价值，尤其是自动化集成和远程控制理念可迁移至养殖场的饲料配送系统。

Latest grain-handling equipment focuses on capacity and convenience

What’s New From the Shows: Grain-handling systems boost capacity with larger air systems, faster conveyors, integrated automation and improved safety features.

Andy Castillo,Editor of Farm Equipment and Machinery,Farm ProgressOctober 7, 2026

photo_library10 Slides

play_arrowStart slideshow

New grain-handling products released at this year’s Farm Progress Show are pushing capacity limits and making equipment easier to use. Several companies introduced larger-diameter air systems at the show that move more grain without traditional grain legs. Vari-Air’s 100-hp system moves 3,200 bushels per hour, while their 8-inch grain vac handles 4,500 bushels per hour. Walinga now offers 7- to 10-inch air systems with bigger blowers and air locks to handle increased volumes.

AGI’s new PTO-driven Batco LCX4 Swing Conveyor moves 9,000 bushels per hour using smaller tractors, eliminating the need for high horsepower to power conveyors. The mechanical swing design is a first in the industry. AGI also introduced a bucket elevator designed around maintenance access, with multiple inspection doors and removable panels that reduce downtime.

Automation and control systems are getting more integrated. Shivvers’ Apex Command Center combines dryer control with storage bin monitoring in one system, managing temperature, moisture and fan operation together. KSI updated its bin fill conveyor with a 180-degree swing-away option and remote control, plus introduced a seed treater with helical mixing technology.

Related:Revolutionary farm tech turns science fiction into reality

Safety equipment includes Walinga’s Bin Rescue Air-Vac, designed specifically for grain entrapment emergencies. The hydraulic-powered skid vac offers portable cleanup capability using existing skid loaders. These products reflect the industry’s focus on moving more grain faster while making equipment more practical for daily farm operations.

About the Author

Andy Castillo

Editor of Farm Equipment and Machinery, Farm Progress

Andy Castillo started his career in journalism about a decade ago as a television news cameraperson and producer before transitioning to a regional newspaper covering western Massachusetts, where he wrote about local farming. Between military deployments with the Air Force and covering the news, he earned an MFA in creative nonfiction writing from Bay Path University, building on the English degree he earned from the University of Massachusetts Amherst. In his role at Farm Progress, Castillo covers agricultural technology, new machinery and the constantly evolving farm equipment marketplace.

Castillo splits his time between the open road and western Massachusetts with his wife, Brianna, a travel nurse who specializes in pediatric oncology, and their rescue pup, Rio. When not attending farm shows, Castillo enjoys playing music, snowboarding, writing, cooking and restoring their 1920 craftsman bungalow. You can find Castillo at farm machinery shows across the country.

translationZh:
今年农场进步展上发布的新粮食处理产品正在突破产能极限，同时让设备更易于使用。多家公司在展会上推出了更大直径的气力系统，无需传统的粮食提升机即可输送更多粮食。Vari-Air的100马力系统每小时可输送3200蒲式耳，而其8英寸粮食真空吸料机每小时可处理4500蒲式耳。Walinga现在提供7至10英寸的气力系统，配备更大的鼓风机和气锁以处理增加的输送量。

AGI新推出的PTO驱动Batco LCX4摆动式输送机使用较小的拖拉机即可每小时输送9000蒲式耳，消除了为大功率输送机配备高马力拖拉机的需求。这种机械摆动设计在行业内属首创。AGI还推出了一款以便于维护为设计理念的斗式提升机，配备多个检修门和可拆卸面板，可减少停机时间。

自动化和控制系统正变得更加集成化。Shivvers的Apex指挥中心将烘干机控制与仓储粮仓监控整合在一个系统中，统一管理温度、水分和风机运行。KSI更新了其粮仓填充输送机，增加了180度摆开选项和远程控制功能，并推出了一款采用螺旋混合技术的种子处理机。

安全设备方面包括Walinga的粮仓救援空气真空吸料机，专为粮食掩埋紧急情况设计。这款液压驱动的滑移式真空设备利用现有滑移装载机即可提供便携式清理能力。这些产品反映了行业对更快输送更多粮食的关注，同时使设备在日常农场运营中更加实用。
